name: Oppo Rancisis
subtitle: Ancient Councilor
text:
This unit gains [Ambush] while another friendly unit has [Ambush]. The same is true for [Grit], [Hidden], [Overwhelm], [Saboteur], [Sentinel], and [Shielded].
This unit gains [Raid 2] while another friendly unit has [{Keyword}]Raid{/keyword}. The same is true for [{Keyword}]Restore{/keyword}.
